## UCL themed plots

[You can animate groups of data within a plot using the Quarto classes `.rstack` and `.fragment` along with the `data` argument in `ggplot2` geoms:]{.much-smaller}

:::{.r-stack}
::::{.fragment}
```{r}
#| label: plot-1
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4
mtcars2 <- within(mtcars, {
  vs <- factor(vs, labels = c("V-shaped", "Straight"))
  am <- factor(am, labels = c("Automatic", "Manual"))
  cyl  <- factor(cyl)
  gear <- factor(gear)
})

ggplot(mtcars2, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = gear)) +
  geom_point(data=~ filter(., gear == 3)) +
  theme_ucl() +
  scale_color_manual(values=ucl_other_palette) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(1, 6), ylim=c(0, 35))
```
::::

::::{.fragment}
```{r}
#| label: plot-2
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(mtcars2, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = gear)) +
  geom_point(data=~ filter(., gear %in% c(3,4))) +
  theme_ucl() +
  scale_color_manual(values=ucl_other_palette) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(1, 6), ylim=c(0, 35))
```
::::

::::{.fragment}
```{r}
#| label: plot-3
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4
plot1 <- ggplot(mtcars2, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = gear)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_ucl() +
  scale_color_manual(values=ucl_other_palette) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(1, 6), ylim=c(0, 35))

plot1
```
::::
:::


[@ggplot]{.bottom-left .tiny}

## UCL themed plots

[Another option is to combine plots using `patchwork`, revealing different subplots using the function `hide_plot`:]{.much-smaller}


:::{.r-stack}
::::{.fragment}
```{r}
#| label: plot2-1
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
(plot1 + hide_plot(plot1)) +
  plot_layout(guides="collect")
```
::::

::::{.fragment}
```{r}
#| label: plot2-2
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
(plot1 + plot1) +
  plot_layout(guides="collect")
```
::::
:::

[@patchwork]{.bottom-left .tiny}
